name: Petronas Twin Towers
description: The 452m steel-clad icons of KL. Ride to the Skybridge and observation deck for the view.

name: Batu Caves
description: A rainbow staircase of 272 steps climbs to vast limestone temple caves guarded by a golden statue.

name: KL Tower (Menara KL)
description: Telecoms tower on Bukit Nanas with a glass Sky Box jutting over the skyline.

name: Merdeka Square
description: Where independence was declared in 1957, framed by the Moorish Sultan Abdul Samad Building.

name: Jalan Alor Food Street
description: KL's most famous open-air hawker street - satay, char kway teow and grilled seafood after dark.

name: Lot 10 Hutong
description: A basement food court gathering heritage hawker stalls - many decades-old recipes under one roof.

name: Old China Cafe
description: Nyonya classics in a restored guild house - try the chicken kapitan and sago gula melaka.

name: Petaling Street (Chinatown)
description: Lantern-lit market lanes of Chinatown - bargain stalls, herbal teas and street snacks.

name: Central Market (Pasar Seni)
description: Art-deco heritage hall of batik, handicrafts and local artists since 1888.

name: Kampung Baru
description: A traditional Malay village of timber houses in the shadow of the towers - great for nasi lemak.

name: KLCC Park
description: Landscaped 20-hectare park at the foot of the towers, with a wading pool and evening fountains.

name: Perdana Botanical Garden
description: KL's oldest park - lake, orchid and hibiscus gardens, and the Lake Gardens greenery.
